intro.text: This application allows you to reveal entries (videos, texts and key references) hidden in the printed publication *{{title}}*.

marginalia.text: In the context of this publication, these entries are called ‘marginalia’.

camera.text:
This application requires access to your camera.

Please, grant access to proceed.

scroller.text:
To activate content in the printed publication, use the horizontal scroll located at the bottom of your screen.

Match page numbers in the app and in the book.

icon.text:
Scan the pages of the book with your camera. Tap on AR marginalia to access an entry.

Unlocked marginalia are saved as you browse. Tap the icon located at the top of your screen to consult them and access general menu.
